purpose: Runtime contract for coarse zone/site resolution needed by rotation/team-entry. Full callout geometry is optional; coarse macro zones are required for full MVP coverage.

providers.description: Per-map normalized minimap polygons for coarse A/B/Mid/Spawn/Main groups. Preferred and required for high-confidence named macro events.
Optional fallback: detect A/B site label anchors on the minimap and use conservative proximity/persistence bands for macro site grouping only.

map_entry_schema.peek_exposure_anchors: optional separate registry; never inferred by VLM
